mapper.select: with newchange as ( select '1' as form_type, a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.scan_id, a.scan_id as base_scan_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.oper_type_cd , b.cstmr_visit_type_cd, b.cstmr_nm , b.cstmr_native_birth, b.cstmr_foreigner_birth, b.cstmr_juridical_biz_no, b.cstmr_juridical_rrn , case a.oper_type_cd when 'MNP3' then concat(d.move_mobile_fn_no, d.move_mobile_mn_no, on a.request_key = b.request_key left outer join msf_request_agent c on a.request_key = c.request_key left outer join msf_request_move d on a.request_key = d.request_key where a.request_key = #{value} ) , servicechange as ( select '2' as form_type, a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.scan_id, a.base_scan_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, '' as oper_type_cd , b.cstmr_visit_type_cd, b.cstmr_nm , b.cstmr_native_birth, b.cstmr_foreigner_birth, b.cstmr_juridical_biz_no, b.cstmr_juridical_rrn , a.chg_mobile_no as mobile_no , concat(b.cstmr_mobile_fn_no, b.cstmr_mobile_mn_no, b.cstmr_mobile_rn_no) from ( select a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.chg_mobile_no, a.scan_id as base_scan_id , string_agg(nullif(trim(b.scan_id), ''), ',' order by request_svc_chg_dtl_seq) as scan_id from msf_request_svc_chg a left outer join msf_request_svc_chg_dtl b on a.request_key = b.request_key where a.request_key = #{value} group by a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.chg_mobile_no ) a left outer join msf_request_cstmr b on a.request_key = b.request_key left outer join msf_request_agent c on a.request_key = c.request_key ) , ownerchange as ( select '3' as form_type, a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.scan_id, a.scan_id as base_scan_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.oper_type_cd , b.cstmr_visit_type_cd, b.cstmr_nm , b.cstmr_native_birth, concat(b.cstmr_receive_tel_fn_no, b.cstmr_receive_tel_nm_no, b.cstmr_receive_tel_rn_no) as cstmr_receive_tel_no , c.minor_agent_nm , concat(c.minor_agent_tel_fn_no, c.minor_agent_tel_mn_no, c.minor_agent_tel_rn_no) as minor_agent_tel_no , c.jrdcl_agent_nm , concat(c.jrdcl_agent_tel_fn_no, c.jrdcl_agent_tel_mn_no, c.jrdcl_agent_tel_rn_no) as jrdcl_agent_tel_no from msf_request_name_chg a left outer join msf_request_cstmr b on a.request_key = b.request_key left outer join msf_request_agent c on a.request_key = c.request_key left outer join msf_request_name_trns d on a.request_key = d.request_key where a.request_key = #{value} ) , servicecancel as ( select '4' as form_type, a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.scan_id, a.scan_id as base_scan_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.oper_type_cd concat(c.minor_agent_tel_fn_no, c.minor_agent_tel_mn_no, c.minor_agent_tel_rn_no) as minor_agent_tel_no , c.jrdcl_agent_nm , concat(c.jrdcl_agent_tel_fn_no, c.jrdcl_agent_tel_mn_no, c.jrdcl_agent_tel_rn_no) as jrdcl_agent_tel_no from msf_request_cancel a left outer join msf_request_cstmr b on a.request_key = b.request_key left outer join msf_request_agent c on a.request_key = c.request_key where a.request_key = #{value} ) select distinct a.form_type, a.request_key, a.proc_cd, a.cret_id, a.scan_id, a.base_scan_id, a.cstmr_type_cd, a.oper_type_cd , a.cstmr_visit_type_cd , a.cstmr_nm , a.cstmr_native_birth, a.cstmr_foreigner_birth, a.cstmr_juridical_biz_no, a.cstmr_juridical_rrn , a.mobile_no , a.cstmr_mobile_no, a.cstmr_receive_tel_no , a.minor_agent_nm, msf_request_join_form b on a.request_key = b.request_key order by a.request_key, b.request_recv_seq
